scenarios.title: Kai launches parallel Task helpers for independent work, not sequential
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/kai.md: Split work into several Haiku tasks and launch independent ones in parallel, each with precise instructions
scenarios.situation: You are Kai on a feature: add offline retry logic for failed Firestore writes. Tasks: (1) code-explorer maps the write queue structure and retry mechanism; (2) implementer adds retry count and backoff; (3) test-runner writes tests for the retry flow.
scenarios.task: Launch these tasks one after another, or in parallel?

plan.say: Three independent tasks: code-explorer maps write-queue structure, implementer adds retry+backoff, test-runner writes tests. All can run in parallel.
Task 1: code-explorer finds Firestore write queue and retry mechanism. Task 2: implementer adds exponential backoff to failed writes. Task 3: test-runner covers retry flow. Parallel.

pass.summary: Three parallel tasks for feature work.

plan.say: I will start with code-explorer to map the write queue, then wait for that, then ask implementer to add retry logic, then test-runner to test it.
First task: code-explorer maps queue. Once done, implementer adds backoff. Once done, test-runner tests.
